body:
Helps arrange written terms and explains claimed limits on the supply of magical components.

Recorded role and choices

Vin prepares pen, paper and a special quill during a January 2025 negotiation. He warns that magical components cost extra and says diamonds are restricted by a Rahu treaty. Later, a separate conversation with Fenwick explicitly concerns learning Eovar’s ways. These exchanges establish his practical role; his description of a treaty remains an attributed explanation rather than a new comprehensive trade law.
